# Independent log aggregator fixtures

These fixtures are hand-written representative log lines.

They are intentionally not generated by `tools/log_aggregator.py`.

Purpose:
- validate JSON log parsing
- validate plain text log parsing
- validate nginx access log parsing
- validate malformed/unsupported input does not crash parsing

The nginx fixture also protects parser routing: the aggregator should try
specific parsers before the generic text parser, otherwise nginx access logs
are swallowed as plain text.
